data.body: [P2] Adding an eighth component changes this public record's contract: existing seven-component record patterns no longer compile, while equality, hashing, reflection, and serializer-visible shape also change. Retaining the old constructors does not preserve these behaviors. Keep `InvocationInfo` at seven components and pass the snapshot through separate immutable metadata, such as a new default plugin-hook overload that delegates to the existing `onInvocationStart(InvocationInfo)` method.
